Apple will unveil the iPhone 18 Pro next month. Should you buy an iPhone now, or wait for the iPhone 18 Pro? My recommendation this year is a little different, for the reasons below.

iPhone 17 Pro vs. iPhone 18 Pro

Every year around this time I usually tell people to wait and see what the new iPhone brings—unless your phone is truly broken and you have to replace it right away.

But my advice is different this year. Signs point to a price hike for both the iPhone 18 Pro and the iPhone 18 Pro Max. The final amount of the increase is still unknown, but according to rumours, the base price of each model could rise by US$200 to US$300.

  • iPhone 18 Pro starting price: US$1,299 to US$1,399 (original price US$1,099)
  • iPhone 18 Pro Max starting price: US$1,399 to US$1,499 (original price US$1,199)

Based on this price hike, my recommendation this year is: if you want to upgrade, buy the iPhone 17 Pro now. I don't think the upgrades on the iPhone 18 Pro will be big enough to justify most people waiting a few more months and paying another US$200 to US$300.

If you've already been using your current phone for two years or more, this advice applies even more. For users in this situation, the iPhone 17 Pro would be a significant upgrade.

One more thing to keep in mind is that Apple will discontinue the iPhone 17 Pro after unveiling the iPhone 18 Pro next month. Although you may still be able to find stock at third-party retailers, the price is unlikely to be lower than it is now (and even if it is, it won't be by much).

Finally, looking at long-term use, the iPhone 18 Pro is rumoured to come with the same 12GB of RAM as the iPhone 17 Pro. That means it will receive iOS support and new AI features for many years to come.

What's new on the iPhone 18 Pro?

The iPhone 18 Pro is not expected to be a major update over the iPhone 17 Pro. Here are some of the rumoured highlights of the iPhone 18 Pro:

  • A20 Pro processor: improved performance and efficiency
  • Main camera upgrade: support for variable aperture, giving users greater control over depth of field
  • New colours: light blue, silver, and deep cherry
  • Design changes: the Dynamic Island gets smaller on both models; the iPhone 18 Pro Max will be thicker and heavier
  • New connectivity technology: C2 modem, with possible support for satellite 5G

Of course, Apple surely has more in store for the iPhone 18 Pro than the current rumours suggest. But I still believe that for most people, buying the iPhone 17 Pro now and saving US$200 to US$300 makes more sense than waiting for the iPhone 18 Pro.

One final variable

A more recent rumour suggests Apple may raise the price of the iPhone 17 as early as next week. If that happens, my recommendation could change. But as long as current prices hold, my advice stands.

Conclusion

At the end of the day, I think you should upgrade when you need to. If you don't need a new phone right now, there's simply no rush to buy the iPhone 17 Pro.

What do you think? Should everyone buy the iPhone 17 Pro now to save some money, or wait for the iPhone 18 Pro? Are the rumoured new features worth the price hike? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments section.
